articles.title: Red Roses’ unbeaten streak ends in a thriller with last-gasp try from Canada
articles.summary: WXV: Canada 24-21 England at BMO Field in Toronto. England suffer first defeat since 2022 Women’s Rugby World Cup final. No, there is nothing wrong with whatever device you are reading this on. The scoreline is correct. Yes, it finally happened.
body: Canada had already ended England’s win streak with a 26-all draw in Exeter last month but that was not vengeance enough. The scrum-half Olivia Apps said in the buildup to these matches that Canada had been doing everything they can in 2026 to make it possible to beat England and that is just what they did.

It was Apps who was one of Canada’s standout players in a cold Toronto with Sophie de Goede her usual best and the player of the match DaLeaka Menin a hugely valuable asset. This result is down to Canada’s great performance but England had opportunities to make a difference on the scoreboard. Several tries went begging, the team’s first try coming after 30 minutes, and their defence just could not hold out the repeated attacks put forward by their rivals.

This Test also made history with a record North American crowd for a women’s rugby game with 18,621 in the stands. The fans more than played their part in this landmark result for Canada, whose last home game was in August 2025.

articles.title: Wolves’ Chirewa extends Burnley’s home woes as Vardy’s strike is in vain
articles.summary: The Wolves substitute Tawanda Chirewa struck within seconds of coming off the bench as César Peixoto’s side came from behind to extend Burnley’s home misery at Turf Moor to 21 games without a win.
body: Chirewa had just replaced Sean Neave in the 72nd minute when Mateus Mané pounced on Igor Julio’s heavy touch and sent the 23-year-old Zimbabwe international through to strike an angled shot, which flew into the net despite Grégoire Coudert getting his hands to the effort.
It was a vital victory for the visitors, who had fallen behind to Jamie Vardy’s first Burnley goal before levelling through Fer López.

For Burnley it was a huge blow. Their last league win at home was when they beat Leeds in the Premier League on 18 October, meaning their horror run will extend beyond a year. Sheffield Wednesday established an unwanted English Football League record last season by going 23 games without a win at Hillsborough.

Burnley’s head coach, Nicky Hayen, admitted he does not know what the future holds for him. “I will not give up,” he said. “I am not thinking about [the future] because I don’t want to lose energy. That’s a question for other people.

articles.title: ‘It’s really not a drama’: Carrick sticks to the script after Martínez storm
articles.summary: Manchester United head coach produced a masterclass in dialling down emotion before a tricky trip to Leeds. Michael Carrick returned his most impressive performance precisely when required as he took questions in the midst of the first crisis engulfing him as Manchester United’s manager.
body: His team are bombing in the league after the club’s poorest start since 1986 and out of the Carabao Cup, and after Tuesday’s Champions League defeat at Atlético Madrid Lisandro Martínez showed up ruptures at United by calling out the director of football, Jason Wilcox.
All of this two months into a first full campaign piloting United after last term ended so rosily for the former United midfielder.
On the final day of last season, United won 3-0 at Brighton and Carrick secured an impressive third-place finish, 48 hours after agreeing a two-year deal to continue as head coach.

By last Saturday, United had six points from the first six games after drawing 1-1 with Tottenham at Old Trafford, placing Carrick’s job in jeopardy as the walls closed in on him a fortnight before the clocks go back.

articles.title: Game, set and tache: Carlos Alcaraz joins growing trend for a stylish top lip
articles.summary: Tennis superstar is latest celebrity to sport a ‘refined’ moustache which owes little to bushy Tom Selleck look. The tennis superstar Carlos Alcaraz might have been knocked out of the Shanghai Masters in straight sets earlier this week, but he did so sporting a moustache that became almost as…
body: “I always wanted to step on the court at least once with the moustache,” Alcaraz said. The Spaniard and his team had all agreed to take the facial-hair plunge if he won the Japan Open, which he did for a second straight year. “¡Bigotes para todos!” or “moustaches for everyone”, they apparently cheered at the end of the match.
At Milan fashion week last month, the Wuthering Heights star Jacob Elordi sported a thin strip of hair on his top lip as he watched his girlfriend, Kendall Jenner, model for the Bottega Veneta show.

A moustachioed Harry Styles is roughly halfway through his record-breaking 30-show residency at Madison Square Garden in New York. The actor Timothée Chalamet, who kept his Marty Supreme ’tache on throughout awards season, has been playing around with his facial hair again, adding a goatee.
On TikTok, gen Z men with moustaches are plentiful, as are tutorials for how to grow and style them – alongside almost as many videos from older generations questioning them.

articles.title: Florida high school football standout pulls off stunning feat in just one half
articles.summary: The definition of insanity is trying the same thing over and over again but expecting a different result. One Florida high school football team kept trying the same thing, and it resulted in the same outcome four different times.
body: Tavares kept throwing towards DeLand defensive back Londel Dumas, who didn't have an interception heading into Friday's game. That changed as Dumas picked off four passes in the first half alone in a 73-0 win over the Bulldogs on Oct. 16.
The game was called with 6:50 to play in the third quarter due to weather as DeLand looks to make their push towards a state title in Class 6A.

Dumas made an impact across the defense last season, recording 23 tackles, seven pass breakups, an interception and a forced fumble. Through Friday's game, he had 15 tackles and a pass breakup this season, with opposing offenses often reluctant to challenge him in coverage.
That changed against Tavares, as Dumas turned a game without an interception into a four-pick performance before halftime, three of which came in the first quarter.

articles.title: ‘An embarrassment and incredibly unfair’: Kirk Herbstreit rips Notre Dame’s weak schedule
articles.summary: The Notre Dame Fighting Irish have rolled through the first half of their season, sitting at 6-0 heading into Saturday night’s top-10 showdown with the BYU Cougars in Provo. But one of the most prominent voices in college football isn’t impressed by how they got there.
body: Speaking on ESPN on Friday morning, Kirk Herbstreit called out Notre Dame’s lack of challenging games, labeling the Irish schedule “an embarrassment” as the College Football Playoff gets set to expand to 24 teams.

The No. 2 Fighting Irish have won all six of their games so far, beating Wisconsin, Rice, Michigan State, Purdue, North Carolina, and Stanford. Most of those games weren’t close, either, including last weekend’s 58-7 blowout of Stanford.

After Saturday’s trip to BYU, Notre Dame’s remaining schedule features Navy, Miami, Boston College, SMU, and Syracuse. Outside of BYU, the home game against the Hurricanes looks like the only real test left on the slate.

The Irish know how much the schedule matters, too. Notre Dame was left out of the 12-team playoff field last season after losing to Miami during the regular season. Now, with reports indicating that the CFP will grow to 24 teams for the 2027 season, the debate over who deserves a spot is only going to get louder.

articles.title: Was game of the season contender a statement from Coleraine?
articles.summary: Ruaidhri Higgins expresses his delight at the manner of his Coleraine side's comeback victory away to Larne.
body: Before kick-off on Friday, Ruaidhri Higgins had said it was too early to be talking about statement victories.
But, after a thrilling 3-2 comeback win at title rivals and reigning champions Larne, the Coleraine manager could not help but join in the celebrations in front of the travelling support.
Joel Cooper fired home the winner in a game of the season contender at Inver Park as the Bannsiders overturned a two-goal deficit to inflict a first league defeat of the season on the hosts.
The three points move Coleraine six points clear of Linfield, who have two games in hand, and 11 points clear of Larne, who have four extra matches thanks to their European exploits in the summer.

articles.title: Kaden Honeycutt wins incident-free Phoenix NASCAR Truck race, extends points lead
articles.summary: Kaden Honeycutt earned his fourth win of the 2026 NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series season on Friday, winning a largely uneventful race at Phoenix Raceway. Outside of the Stage 1 end and a Stage 2-ending debris yellow, there were no incident-related cautions.
body: Honeycutt's victory helped increase his championship advantage, now 39pts ahead of Layne Riggs, with Riggs finishing third behind runner-up Christian Eckes.

"My pit crew did a great job, man," said Honeycutt after the win. "I give so much credit to them because they're so damn good... this is so amazing. Phoenix! We finally got one, baby! Woo! Yeah, I just can't say nothing about Scott [Zipadelli, crew chief]. My crew, David, Tim, Chuck, Adam, Cube -- everyone that works so dang hard on these race trucks. Man, I'm so fortunate to be able to drive these things, and, um, they spent all their hours of the day just for me to drive them. And I can't be more grateful for them, and so grateful for the opportunity at Toyota Racing and TRICON... just, so awesome."
He also announced a cool new tradition, as he will give away a helmet to a young fan after every race win.
Ty Majeski, who swept both stages, finished fourth, and Jake Garcia rounded out the top five. William Sawalich, Daniel Hemric, Gio Ruggiero, Grant Enfinger, and Brent Crews completed the top ten.

articles.title: Gloucester claim thrilling draw against Champions Cup holders Bordeaux
articles.summary: Will Trenholm’s brace was not enough to help Gloucester pull off a stunning upset against Champions Cup holders Bordeaux, as they were forced to settle for a 36-36 draw after a dramatic contest.
body: George Skivington's team pushed the French outfit all the way during a pulsating European tie at Kingsholm Stadium.
Gloucester held a 24-17 lead at half-time before Trenholm crashed over twice, but a double by Louis Bielle-Biarrey salvaged a share of the spoils for visiting Bordeaux.
Bordeaux made a fast start, with Martin Page-Relo able to open the scoring in the fourth minute, but Arthur Clark produced an instant reply for Gloucester.
Efforts by Max Llewellyn and George Barton, either side of Sipili Falatea's try, earned the hosts a slender seven-point advantage at the break thanks to three successful conversions by Barton.

articles.title: United States GP: UK schedule as F1 returns to COTA
articles.summary: Following an extended stint across Asia, Formula 1 heads to America for the United States Grand Prix at the iconic Circuit of The Americas in Austin, Texas.
body: After the previous triple-header saw Kimi Antonelli move closer to a maiden F1 title, the Mercedes driver enters three more back-to-back races knowing he has every chance of sealing a historic triumph.

The Italian is 102 points clear of his Mercedes team-mate George Russell at the top of the standings, with the first two victories of the year for Red Bull and Max Verstappen only having helped Antonelli move clear of the pack, leaving him with a small chance of being crowned champion in Austin.

While both Antonelli and Mercedes are in remarkably strong positions in the championships, the competitive picture has rarely been more exciting during the 2026 season, with each of the top four teams entering each weekend with genuine hopes of victory.

Many eyes will be on Antonelli, but Verstappen's quest to complete a hat-trick of wins, along with Lewis Hamilton's attempts to bounce back from a tough Sunday in Singapore promise to provide plenty of entertainment.

articles.title: Ranking the Premier League's all-time greatest super subs
articles.summary: Some players are destined to make their biggest impact off the bench, but who are the top 10 Premier League super subs of all time?
body: Mikel Arteta may be attempting to rebrand them "finishers" but there's only one phrase in the footballing lexicon to sum up today's focus: super subs.
Yes, we're looking for those players renowned for making a devastating impact off the bench, those guaranteed game-changers a manager turns to when in desperate need of a goal.

First, an honorary mention for some who missed out, such as one-season wonder Adam le Fondre, who holds the record for the most goals off the bench in a single Premier League campaign - five of his eight came in a three-game spell in January 2013.

Hernan Crespo boasts the best goals-per-game ratio but his six in 16 substitute appearances for Chelsea represents a small sample size, likewise ex-Norwich and Leicester forward Mark Robins with five in 14 outings as a replacement.

articles.title: McIlroy plays just four holes of second round due to bad light in India
articles.summary: Rory McIlroy is four shots off the clubhouse lead but only four holes into his second round at the DP World India Championship after play was suspended early on Friday due to bad light in New Delhi.
body: Torrential rain on the Thursday resulted in a five-hour delay to the opening round, and there were further frustrations for those still out on the course when play was halted just before 6pm local time on Friday.

McIlroy, who is bidding to win the Race to Dubai title for a record-equalling eighth time, opened the tournament with a two-under 70 on Thursday, while he started his second round with an eagle to sit four under when play was stopped shortly after.

Dutchman Joost Luiten, who had to play 34 holes on Friday because of the delays, Angel Hidalgo and Alfred Dunhill Links Championship winner Adrian Meronk were all able to finish their second rounds, and top the leaderboard on eight under.
Belgian Thomas Detry is also eight under, but is only through six holes of his second round, for which he is currently three under.

articles.title: The All Blacks' Haka explained - plus rugby's other rituals
articles.summary: One of the most intriguing and anticipated moments in the sport of rugby union: the sight of New Zealand's All Blacks performing their world-famous haka as the opposition stands before them.
body: But how much do you know about the haka? And also of the three other ceremonial war dances which take place in rugby: the Cibi, Siva Tau and Sipi Tau.

An ancient traditional Māori practice, there is no single recorded date for the haka's first-ever performance owing to this very reason. It has been practised by indigenous Māori communities for centuries.
The earliest point at which Europeans witnessed the haka was the 18th century: Joseph Banks and James Cook on their first voyage to New Zealand in 1769 recorded the haka as "vigorous and ferocious".

In terms of its introduction into sport, New Zealand's first rugby union side visited Australia in Sydney in 1884 and performed the haka. During 1888/89, a 'New Zealand native team' toured the UK for the first time, performing the haka on October 3 1888 against Surrey in a tour match.
